posts.title: Before the next scroll
posts.status: Final copy for production; not published
posts.caption:
The alarm stops. You pick up your phone to check the time. A few minutes later, your thumb is still moving.

We are building Shanivar around moments like this: beginning the day, protecting time for something you choose, and taking a short pause.

Meet Steady, our breathing and attention experience in development. Breathe. Return. Begin.

The direction is simple: make room for a pause before focused work or as the day ends. We will share release news when availability is verified.

For today, no app is needed for this question: before the next scroll, what matters now?

Follow @app.shanivar for build updates.

#Shanivar #Steady #IntentionalLiving

posts.title: The laptop is closed
posts.status: Final copy for production; not published
posts.caption:
The laptop is closed. The work lamp is still on. You sit down for a break and open the same app again.

Sometimes a free evening begins with a question we have not asked yet: what would I like this time to be for?

Tea while it is warm. A few pages. A call. Doing very little. Your answer can be small.

If it suits tonight, put the phone beside you and begin that one thing. You can decide what happens after.

Save the question for the next evening that starts on autopilot.

#Shanivar #EverydayAttention #IntentionalLiving

posts.title: Two cups, one question
posts.status: Final copy for production; not published
posts.caption:
Two cups on the table. Your parent starts a story you have heard before. Your phone lights up.

You could ask what you have never asked: what do you remember most about that day?

If you both feel like talking, let the phones sit aside for one cup of tea. There is no need to turn the conversation into a lesson about anyone's habits.

And if today is not the day, the invitation can wait.

Try one curious question with someone who welcomes it.

#Shanivar #EverydayAttention #FamilyTime
